groups.title: In the documentation
groups.ships: The pages at `/docs`: each diagram in `docs/diagrams/` is built by Archify and carries its viewer and the JetBrains Mono font, and the privacy policy (`docs/guide/privacy.md`) is adapted from Basecamp's. The executable carries the pages.

components.name: Archify
components.note: The viewer script and styles inside each diagram are Archify's. No brand mark from Archify's catalogue is used.

components.name: JetBrains Mono
components.version: Google Fonts subsets, as Archify 3.0.1 embeds them
components.note: Each diagram also carries this licence inside the page, beside the font.

components.name: Basecamp policies
components.note: The privacy policy at `/privacy` is adapted from these policies by 37signals. The page says so at its end, with a link to the licence, and says that it was changed.
